title: 看病与药店
purpose: 描述症状、预约看病、买药和紧急情况

words.e: If you feel ill at school, go to the nurse.
words.c: 如果在学校感到不舒服，就去找校医。

words.e: I don't feel very well. I have a headache and a sore throat.
words.c: 我感觉不太舒服。我头痛，喉咙也痛。

words.e: I have a stomach ache after eating too fast.
words.c: 我吃得太快，肚子疼。

words.e: I've had a cough since Monday.
words.c: 我从周一开始咳嗽。

words.e: She has the flu, so she's staying in bed.
words.c: 她得了流感，所以卧床休息。

words.e: My stomach hurts, and I feel a bit dizzy.

words.e: Good idea. If it gets worse, we'll see a doctor.
words.c: 好主意。如果更严重了，我们就去看医生。

words.e: I felt so sick that I thought I would throw up.
words.c: 我恶心得觉得要吐了。

words.e: My arm is itchy and there's a rash.
words.c: 我的胳膊很痒，还起了疹子。

words.e: My ankle is swollen after the football match.
words.c: 踢完足球比赛后我的脚踝肿了。

words.e: A high temperature is a common symptom of flu.
words.c: 发高烧是流感的常见症状。

words.e: Cover your mouth when you sneeze.
words.c: 打喷嚏时要捂住嘴。

I think I have a fever.

patterns.sit: 你想说明喉咙什么时候疼

patterns.en: I feel dizzy.
patterns.sit: 你站起来时觉得天旋地转

lines.en: Emma, you look pale. Are you OK?
lines.zh: 艾玛，你脸色苍白。你还好吗？

lines.en: I don't feel very well. I have a headache and a sore throat.
lines.zh: 我感觉不太舒服。我头痛，喉咙也痛。

lines.en: Oh dear. How long have you felt like this?
Since last night. And I feel really tired.
lines.zh: 从昨晚开始。而且我觉得很累。

lines.en: Let me check your temperature. ... It's thirty-eight point two. You have a fever.
lines.zh: 我给你量一下体温。……三十八点二度，你发烧了。

lines.en: Should I go to school today?
No, you should stay at home and rest. I'll call the school.
lines.zh: 不，你应该在家休息。我给学校打电话。

lines.en: Thank you. Do we have any medicine?
Yes, I'll get you some paracetamol and a glass of water.
lines.zh: 有，我给你拿点扑热息痛和一杯水。

lines.en: Thanks. I'll go back to bed.
Good idea. If it gets worse, we'll see a doctor.
lines.zh: 好主意。如果更严重了，我们就去看医生。

lines.en: Hello, Emma. What's the matter?
My stomach hurts, and I feel a bit dizzy.
When did it start?
About an hour ago, after lunch.
Have you thrown up?
No, but I feel sick.
Did you eat anything unusual at lunch?
lines.zh: 你午饭吃了什么特别的东西吗？

lines.en: I had a prawn sandwich. Maybe I'm allergic to prawns.
lines.zh: 我吃了一个虾仁三明治。也许我对虾过敏。

lines.en: Hmm, maybe. Lie down here for a while, and I'll call your host family.
lines.zh: 嗯，有可能。先在这儿躺一会儿，我给你的寄宿家庭打电话。

lines.en: Thank you.

words.e: The doctor's surgery opens at eight thirty.
words.c: 诊所八点半开门。

words.e: If you feel ill, you should see your GP.
words.c: 如果你不舒服，应该去看全科医生。

words.e: Hello. I'd like to make an appointment to see a doctor, please.
words.c: 你好。我想预约看医生。

words.e: Are you registered with us?
words.c: 你在我们这里注册过吗？

words.e: The receptionist asked for my name and date of birth.
words.c: 接待员问了我的姓名和出生日期。

words.e: Let me check. We have a doctor available at four fifteen today.
words.c: 我查一下。今天四点十五分有一位医生有空。

words.e: It's quite urgent.
words.c: 挺紧急的。

words.e: Please wait in the waiting room until the doctor calls you.
words.c: 请在候诊室等候，医生会叫你。

words.e: I go to the dentist for a check-up twice a year.
words.c: 我一年去牙医那里检查两次。

words.e: The doctor will examine your throat.
words.c: 医生会检查你的喉咙。

words.e: Thanks for telling me. I'll give you a different medicine. Here's your prescription.
words.c: 谢谢你告诉我。我给你开另一种药。这是你的处方。

words.e: The nurse will take your temperature first.
words.c: 护士会先给你量体温。

words.e: The doctor wants me to have a blood test.
words.c: 医生要我验个血。

words.e: Don't worry. It's a chest infection, but it's not serious.
words.c: 别担心。是胸部感染，但不严重。

words.e: Do you have any allergies to food or medicine?
words.c: 你对食物或药物过敏吗？

words.e: In three or four days. Get plenty of rest and drink plenty of water.
words.c: 三四天吧。多休息，多喝水。

words.e: In three or four days. Get plenty of rest and drink plenty of water.
words.c: 三四天吧。多休息，多喝水。

words.e: Please fill in this form about your medical history.
words.c: 请填写这张关于你病史的表格。

words.e: International students need health insurance.
words.c: 国际学生需要健康保险。

words.e: Is it serious?
words.c: 严重吗？

words.e: You'll recover quickly if you rest.
words.c: 你好好休息就会很快康复。

patterns.en: I'd like to make an appointment to see a doctor.
Is there anything available today?
It's quite urgent.
I'm an international student. Do I need to register?
patterns.zh: 我是国际学生，需要注册吗？

patterns.en: I'm allergic to penicillin.
How often should I take it?
Is it serious?
When will I feel better?

lines.en: Good morning, Park Road Surgery.
Hello. I'd like to make an appointment to see a doctor, please.
Are you registered with us?
lines.zh: 你在我们这里注册过吗？

lines.en: Yes, I registered last month. My name is Emma Zhang.
lines.zh: 注册过，我上个月注册的。我叫张艾玛。

lines.en: What's your date of birth?
The third of March, 2014.
Thank you. What's the problem?
I've had a bad cough for a week, and now I have a fever.
lines.zh: 我咳嗽得厉害一个星期了，现在还发烧。

lines.en: Let me check. We have a doctor available at four fifteen today.
lines.zh: 我查一下。今天四点十五分有一位医生有空。

lines.en: Four fifteen is perfect.
Please arrive ten minutes early.
I will. Thank you very much.
Hello, Emma. What seems to be the problem?
I've had a cough for a week, and since yesterday I've had a fever.
lines.zh: 我咳嗽一个星期了，从昨天开始发烧。

lines.en: Let me listen to your chest. Take a deep breath. ... And again.
lines.zh: 我听一下你的胸部。深呼吸。……再来一次。

lines.en: Is it serious?
Don't worry. It's a chest infection, but it's not serious.
lines.zh: 别担心。是胸部感染，但不严重。

lines.en: Do I need any medicine?
Yes. Are you allergic to anything?
I'm allergic to penicillin.
Thanks for telling me. I'll give you a different medicine. Here's your prescription.
lines.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。我给你开另一种药。这是你的处方。

lines.en: When will I feel better?
In three or four days. Get plenty of rest and drink plenty of water.
lines.zh: 三四天吧。多休息，多喝水。

words.e: There's a pharmacy next to the doctor's surgery.
words.c: 诊所旁边有一家药店。

words.e: Ask the pharmacist if you're not sure how to take it.
words.c: 如果不确定怎么服用，就问药剂师。

words.e: Take this medicine with a glass of water.
words.c: 用一杯水送服这种药。

words.e: She took a painkiller for her headache.
words.c: 她吃了一片止痛药来缓解头痛。

words.e: Here you are. These are the tablets the doctor gave you.
words.c: 给你。这是医生给你开的药片。

words.e: Swallow the capsule whole. Don't chew it.
words.c: 整粒吞下胶囊，不要嚼。

words.e: Take two spoons of cough syrup before bed.
words.c: 睡前喝两勺止咳糖浆。

words.e: OK. And do you have plasters? I cut my finger.
words.c: 好的。你们有创可贴吗？我割破了手指。

words.e: Don't take more than the dose on the box.
words.c: 服用量不要超过盒子上写的剂量。

words.e: One tablet, twice a day, after meals.
words.c: 一次一片，一天两次，饭后吃。

words.e: One tablet, twice a day, after meals.
words.c: 一次一片，一天两次，饭后吃。

words.e: Don't take this medicine on an empty stomach.
words.c: 不要空腹服用这种药。

words.e: Do they have any side effects?
words.c: 它们有副作用吗？

words.e: Will it make me drowsy? I have a test tomorrow.
words.c: 它会让我犯困吗？我明天有考试。

words.e: You can buy this medicine over the counter.
words.c: 这种药不用处方就能买到。

words.e: Hi. I'd like to pick up my prescription, please.
words.c: 你好，我想取处方药。

words.e: Put this cream on the rash twice a day.
words.c: 这种药膏一天在皮疹处涂两次。

words.e: Use sun cream to avoid sunburn.
words.c: 用防晒霜避免晒伤。

words.e: OK. And do you have plasters? I cut my finger.
words.c: 好的。你们有创可贴吗？我割破了手指。

words.e: This cream is good for an insect bite.
words.c: 这种药膏对虫咬很有效。

words.e: Read the instructions on the box before you take it.
words.c: 服用前请阅读盒子上的说明。

patterns.en: I'd like to pick up my prescription.
patterns.sit: 你拿着医生开的处方到药店

patterns.en: Do you have anything for a sore throat?
patterns.zh: 你们有治喉咙痛的药吗？

patterns.en: How many tablets should I take?
Should I take it before or after meals?
patterns.zh: 我应该饭前吃还是饭后吃？
patterns.sit: 你不知道什么时候吃药

patterns.en: Does it have any side effects?
patterns.sit: 你担心吃药后会不舒服

patterns.en: Will it make me drowsy?
patterns.sit: 你明天要考试，不想犯困

patterns.en: Can I buy this without a prescription?
patterns.zh: 这个不用处方可以买吗？

lines.en: Hi. I'd like to pick up my prescription, please.
Sure. What's your name?
Emma Zhang.
Here you are. These are the tablets the doctor gave you.
lines.zh: 给你。这是医生给你开的药片。

lines.en: How many tablets should I take?
One tablet, twice a day, after meals.
lines.zh: 一次一片，一天两次，饭后吃。

lines.en: Will it make me drowsy? I have a test tomorrow.
lines.zh: 它会让我犯困吗？我明天有考试。

lines.en: No, it shouldn't make you drowsy. But finish the whole box, even if you feel better.
lines.zh: 不会让你犯困。不过即使好了，也要把一整盒吃完。

lines.en: OK, I'll remember that. Do I need to pay?
lines.zh: 好的，我会记住的。需要付钱吗？

lines.en: You're under sixteen, so it's free.
lines.zh: 你未满十六岁，所以免费。

lines.en: Great. Thank you!
Excuse me, do you have anything for a sore throat?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，你们有治喉咙痛的药吗？

lines.en: Yes. How long have you had it?
Two days. It hurts when I swallow.
Do you have a fever?
No, I don't.
Then these throat sweets should help. Take one every three hours.
lines.zh: 那这些润喉糖应该有用。每三小时吃一颗。

lines.en: Do they have any side effects?
No, but don't take more than eight a day.
lines.zh: 没有，但一天不要超过八颗。

lines.en: OK. And do you have plasters? I cut my finger.
lines.zh: 好的。你们有创可贴吗？我割破了手指。

lines.en: They're on the shelf behind you.
Thanks for your help.
